title: Governor of Telangana Shri Shiv Pratap Shukla meets the Prime Minister
body_text:
The Governor of Telangana Shri Shiv Pratap Shukla met with Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi. The Prime Minister's Office posted on X: "Governor of Telangana, Shri Shiv Pratap Shukla met Prime Minister @narendramodi. @tg_governor" Governor of Telangana, Shri Shiv Pratap Shukla met Prime Minister @narendramodi.

@tg_governor https://t.co/49oeMMRuRi — PMO India (@PMOIndia) October 26, 2026 **** MJPS/SS/PRK
